citationText: “5G Broadcast the Dawn of a New Freedom.” [Online]. Available: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=ZKoigNQNDGUAcronyms3GPP 3rd Generation Partnership Project 5G-MAG 5G Media Action Group ABR Adaptative BitRate ATSC Advanced Television Systems Committee ATSC-MH Advanced Television Systems Committee - Mobile/Handheld AL-FEC Application level forward error correction BM-SC Broadcast/Multicast Service Center CMAF Common media application format DASH Dynamic adaptive streaming over HTTP DTT Digital terrestrial television DVB Digital video broadcasting DVB-H Digital Video Broadcasting - Handheld ENodeB 4G base station FDT File delivery table FLUTE File delivery over unidirectional transport IoT Internet of Things ISO BMFF ISO base media file format eMBMS enhanced Multimedia Broadcast Multicast Service HLS HTTP live streaming HPHT High-power high tower LPLT Low-power low tower LTE Long-term evolution MBMS-GW Multimedia Broadcast Multicast Service - Gateway MCS Modulation and coding scheme MMT MPEG Media Transport OFDM Orthogonal frequency-division multiplexing PSLTE Public safety LTE SBTVD Sistema Brasileiro de TV Digital SFN Single-frequency network SDR Software-defined radio UHF Ultrahigh frequencies About that Authors Christophe Burdinat is the director of technologies and standards at Ateme, France. With more than 15 years of experience in the Mobile Broadcast Industry, from DVB-H/ ATSC-MH/ISDBT-MM to LTE-Broadcast and 5G-Broadcast, in his different roles, he drives product development, research and development collaborative projects, and standardization management. He is a regular delegate and contributor at 3GPP, DVB, and SVA. His expertise covers content delivery protocols, mission-critical/public safety services over mobile networks, multicast ABR, DVB-I, 5G broadcast, and OTT service distribution.
